_comment: Source of truth for per-site USO Portal instances. Add a site here, then run deploy/sync-sites.sh (regenerates the nginx host->port map) + bash deploy/deploy-app.sh uso (starts the instance). Shared values (M-PAiSA creds, VV API URL/secret) live in uso-portal/backend/.env; only the per-site overrides below differ. groupId is optional (the backend resolves the site from its Host); set it to pin the instance explicitly.
